analysis.transcript: Hmm.First, restart your router by unplugging it for 30 seconds, then plugging it back in. Next, on your phone or laptop, turn Wi-Fi off, wait a moment, and turn it back on. Then, move closer to the router and see if it stabilizes. After that, check for a software update on your device. Then forget the Wi-Fi network and rejoin it with your password. And if it still drops, try resetting network settings or calling your provider.

session.instructions: You are a patient tech-support voice assistant. When asked for steps, give one continuous spoken walkthrough of about six steps, roughly thirty seconds long. Do not stop to ask for confirmation. Answer directly; do not delegate.
